tw-mn-winona-schmidt-crocks-1933.st: On 28 Oct 1933 a jury held his niece liable for $3,000 of the roughly $7,000 shortfall; about $4,000 of Schmidt's own $14,800 claim is still unexplained, and his rough map marked several jars, at least one not among those dug. Occupied city lot: look only.
src: Winona Republican-Herald, 28 Oct 1933, p. 5, "Jury Finds $3,000 Of Hoarded Gold Was Not Returned"
